raw.details:
Data, code, and pure innovation collide at NexHack—the ultimate offline battleground where developers, designers, and dreamers unite!

Forget getting boxed into one category. We are throwing multiple tracks your way! Whether you are building real-world AI solutions, decentralized Web3 systems, or completely out-of-the-box open innovations, this is your arena to build something that actually matters. So go ahead, tame the chaotic bugs before they slow down your progress!

For more information about the hackathon and related queries visit our website -- Nexhack 2.0

Timeline & The Battle Plan

  • Day 1 (24 November) Action: Problem statements for all tracks will be officially announced live on the first day of the hackathon!
  • The Format: No online qualifiers, no hiding behind screens at home. This is a 100% full offline mode experience.
  • Day 2 (25 November) Showdown: The second round of rigorous judging happens on Day 2, and top 15 teams will be announced immediately after who will compete for the ultimate prizes 
  • Venue: Geeta University, Naultha, Panipat. (Get ready to live on campus for 24 hours of non-stop coding!)

️ The Golden Rules & Guidelines

  • Eligibility: Everyone is welcome! If you have the skills to build, you have a spot here.
  • Team Configuration: 2 to 4 members per team. Grab your best coders, collaborators, innovators and bug squashers.
  • Deliverables: Keep your eyes peeled! The exact submission deliverables (like your GitHub repos and presentation decks) will be announced on hackathon day and officially shared in the rulebook on our website.
  • Code Integrity: Your code must run end-to-end. There is zero tolerance for plagiarism, so keep it original and keep it clean.

Logistics & Survival Guide

  • Travel: We’ve got your back on the commute! Free travel is provided directly from the Panipat Bus Stand and Panipat Railway Station to the venue for all arriving participants.
  • Accommodation: Please note that no accommodation is being provided right now prior before the event starts.

Prizes & Glory

Winning teams won't just walk away with serious bragging rights. We’ve got cash prizes, swags, certificates, and epic tech rewards waiting for the champions!
